last_outcome: P8.2 toast notification stack shipped — `src/ui/toast.ts` exports `pushToast(text)` (plus `visibleToastCount/queuedToastCount` for introspection). Internal queue holds at most `MAX_VISIBLE=3` active `.toast` divs at a time; further pushes wait in `queue: string[]` and spawn from `drain()` once an older toast finishes its `SHOW_MS=2500` hold + `FADE_MS=250` fade-out. `spawn` appends a `.toast` div into `#toast-container`, forces a layout flush (`void el.offsetWidth`) so the CSS transition runs from the initial state, then adds `.show` to drive opacity 0→1 + translateY(40px→0) over 250ms. `beginDismiss` removes `.show`, schedules DOM removal `FADE_MS` later, then calls `drain()` so the queue advances exactly once per slot freed. `index.html` replaces the ad-hoc `#pickup-toast` div + CSS with `#toast-container` (bottom-center flex column, gap 8px, z-index 8, pointer-events: none) + `.toast`/`.toast.show` rules matching the plan spec (280px wide, dark bg, white text, monospace, amber border, drop shadow). `src/main.ts` imports `pushToast`, removes the legacy `showPickupToast`+`toastTimer` helper, and on a successful `addItem` calls `pushToast("+N Item Name")`. `__voxelTest__` gains `toast(text)` so the gate can push directly without firing pickups. `scripts/validate-visual.mjs` P8.2 block pushes 4 toasts via the hook, asserts exactly 3 `.toast` elements exist with the first three texts (4th queued, not in DOM), waits up to 4.5s for the 4th to materialise after the first toast's full 2500+250ms cycle, asserts final count is ≤3, captures `iter-${ITER}-toast.png`. Build green 524.25 kB (+0.46 kB vs iter 44's 523.79 kB). Next: P8.3 (time-of-day HUD label under minimap).
